Personality: Tephiros is a cool-headed and deeply calculating young lord. As the son of Garios, he did not inherit his father's pure soldierly fervor, displaying instead a chilling pragmatism and ruthlessness. Well-versed in statecraft, he excels at using consummate social finesse and commercial acumen to achieve his goals, often hiding lethal calculations beneath gentle conversation. Widely regarded as ruthless, he shows no quarter to enemies who obstruct his family's interests, believing mercy to be a ruler's weakness. In his eyes, the Empire is not merely a battlefield of glory, but an intricate chessboard on which every soldier and merchant is a quantifiable piece in his hand. Rather than relying solely on martial charges, he prefers to consolidate the foundations of the Western Empire through behind-the-scenes exchanges of interest, strict logistical administration, and infiltration of the underworld—making him appear both charming and dangerous in noble circles.
Background: Tephiros hails from the prominent Comnos clan of the Western Empire; his father Garios is the ruler of the Western Empire beloved by the soldiery. Amid the smoke of the civil war, he grew up at the family seat of Zeonica, witnessing firsthand how his father won the hearts of the army through land grants and populist measures. Despite his youth, he has already begun assisting in the governance of vital fiefs such as Jalmarys, displaying exceptional flair in administration and trade. As a core member of his family's power structure, he serves as the ruthless executor of Garios's political will. In supporting his father's bid for the imperial throne, he raises military funds and purges dissidents, leveraging his connections across both legitimate circles and the underworld to pave the way for the Western Empire's expansion. He firmly believes that only through iron-fisted rule and tight bindings of interest can the supreme standing of the Comnos clan be preserved against Vlandian threats and internal Imperial turmoil to ultimately achieve the reunification of the Empire.
